subject: general
question: ICC Women's T-20 Cricket World Cup is a/an ________ event.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ICC Women's T-20 Cricket World Cup is a biennial event**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The ICC Women's T-20 Cricket World Cup is held every two years, making it a **biennial event**.
 
• The tournament is governed by the **International Cricket Council (ICC)** and features top women's cricket teams from across the globe.
 
• The inaugural edition of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup was held in **2009 in England**.
 
• Australia is the most successful team in the tournament's history, winning **six titles as of 2023**.
 
• The competition follows the T20 format, with **20 overs per side**, offering a fast-paced and action-packed cricketing experience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC Women's Cricket World Cup**

 
 
• This is a separate tournament from the T20 World Cup and follows a **One-Day International (ODI) format**.
 
• It is held every **four years** and features 50-over matches.
 
• The first Women's Cricket World Cup was held in **1973 in England**, two years before the men's version.
 
• Australia also dominates the Women's ODI World Cup, with the most titles in its history.
 
 
 
• **T20 Cricket Format**
 
 
• T20 cricket consists of a maximum of **20 overs per team**, making it shorter and more dynamic than other formats.
 
• This format was introduced to attract a wider and younger audience to cricket.
 
• Matches are typically completed in approximately **three hours**, making it suitable for modern sports entertainment.
 
• T20 cricket emphasizes **aggressive batting, innovative bowling, and dynamic fielding**.
 
 
 
• **International Cricket Council (ICC)**
 
 
• The ICC is the governing body of international cricket, founded in **1909** as the Imperial Cricket Conference.
 
• It is headquartered in **Dubai, UAE**, and oversees all major international cricket tournaments.
 
• The ICC aims to grow the sport globally, promoting inclusivity and gender equality.
 
 
 
• **Women's Cricket Development**
 
 
• Women's cricket has grown significantly in popularity and professionalism in recent years.
 
• Leagues like the **Women's Big Bash League** in Australia and **The Hundred** in England have contributed to its development.
 
• Increased media coverage and sponsorship have boosted visibility and financial support for women's cricket.
 
• Initiatives like the ICC Women's T20 World Cup have provided a platform for showcasing women's talent at an international level.
